title: GIDEON
subtitle: 300 vs. the army that destroyed itself

lines.say: [nervous] ...That jar was already broken.
[dryly] The last time someone smashed jars at night... a whole army destroyed itself.
cap: The last time someone smashed jars at night...

lines.say: [shocked] A WHOLE ARMY?!
[storytelling] Israel was being crushed by the Midianites. Every harvest, they swarmed in like locusts. Too many camels to count.
cap: Israel was being crushed by the {r:Midianites}.
Every harvest, they swarmed in like {r:locusts}.

lines.say: So Israel hid in caves. And one young man named Gideon was threshing wheat... hiding in a winepress.
cap: was threshing wheat... hiding in a {o:winepress}.

lines.say: [resonant] The Lord is with you... mighty warrior.
[laughing] MIGHTY WARRIOR?! He's hiding in a hole!
[nervous] Me? My clan is the weakest in Manasseh... and I'm the least in my family.
cap: and I'm the {o:least} in my family.”

lines.say: But God chose him anyway. Gideon gathered thirty-two thousand men. The enemy? Like sand on the seashore.
cap: The enemy? Like {r:sand on the seashore}.

lines.say: [serious] And God said... you have too many men.
[outraged] TOO MANY?!
Anyone who's afraid, go home. Twenty-two thousand went home.
Still too many. So God tested them at the water... and kept only three hundred.
cap: So God tested them at the {g:water}...

lines.say: [panicked] Three hundred?! That's not an army, that's a SNACK!
cap: That's not an army, that's a {o:SNACK}!

lines.say: [knowingly] Exactly. So no one could say, we saved ourselves.
[whispers] That night, Gideon crept down to the enemy camp. And he heard a soldier telling a nightmare.
cap: That night, Gideon crept down to the {r:enemy camp}.
And he heard a soldier telling a {r:nightmare}.

lines.say: [terrified] [whispers] A loaf of bread came tumbling into our camp... and flattened the tent! It's the sword of Gideon!
cap: “A loaf of bread came tumbling into our camp...

lines.say: [confused] They're scared of... BREAD?
[building] They were already terrified. Gideon gave each man a trumpet... and an empty jar with a torch hidden inside.
cap: and an empty jar with a {o:torch} hidden inside.

lines.say: [whispers] At midnight, they surrounded the camp... and waited.
[shouting] A SWORD FOR THE LORD AND FOR GIDEON!
[intense] Three hundred jars SMASHED. Three hundred torches blazed. Three hundred trumpets from every side.
[intense] The enemy woke up in the dark, surrounded by fire and noise... and in the chaos, they turned their swords on each other.
cap: The enemy woke up in the dark,
they turned their swords on {r:each other}.

lines.say: [shouting] THEY BEAT THEMSELVES?!
[awed] And Gideon's three hundred? Every man just stood in his place.
cap: Every man just {g:stood in his place}.

lines.say: [thinking] But why pick the scared guy hiding in a hole?
[warmly] Because God didn't call him mighty warrior for who he was. He called him who he was about to become.
cap: Because God didn't call him {g:mighty warrior}
He called him who he was about to {g:become}.

lines.say: [tenderly] God isn't waiting for you to be strong enough. He's waiting for you to say yes... so everyone can see it was him.
cap: God isn't waiting for you to be {o:strong enough}.
He's waiting for you to say {g:yes}...
so everyone can see it was {g:Him}.

lines.say: [thoughtful] ...So being small is kind of the point?
cap: ...So being {o:small} is kind of the point?

lines.say: [gently] Being small is exactly the point.
[excited] [shouting] Then I'm PERFECT! A sword for the Lord and for Gideo—
cap: A sword for the Lord and for {o:Gideo—}
